status: HOLD / HUMAN AUTHORITY REQUIRED / NO RHINO EXECUTION
purpose: Prevent installer, EULA, account, license, or runtime actions from occurring until the license owner explicitly authorizes them.

official_boundary.rhino8_eula: Rhino 8 EULA permits use on a computer or VM the license owner owns, leases, rents, or licenses, subject to concurrent-license limits; EULA acceptance remains a human/legal action.
official_boundary.installer_access: Current Rhino 8 Evaluation and Licensed downloads are account/license gated on Rhino3D.com; there is no repo-owned public installer artifact.
official_boundary.evaluation: The 90-day evaluation requires the user to create/login to a Rhino Account, accept McNeel conditions, and obtain the evaluation key; OLEANDER must not perform these actions for the user.
official_boundary.cloud_zoo: Cloud Zoo supports using an owned Rhino license on computers where Rhino is installed, but Rhino Account login/consent is user-controlled. No unattended Cloud Zoo login credential flow is assumed by this contract.
official_boundary.managed_distribution: McNeel documents deployable License Manager folders for managed Mac deployments; standalone license files are system-specific, while LAN Zoo and Cloud Zoo license files can be moved between systems. Any such bundle must be supplied and authorized by the license owner or administrator.

required_human_assertions.note: Must point to a legitimate private/authorized Rhino 8 Mac installer source. The URL value must never be logged.
Presence only may be checked before execution. Secret content must never be printed or committed.

explicitly_disallowed_automation: accept Rhino EULA or evaluation terms on the user's behalf
request or consume a one-time evaluation on the user's behalf
scrape or replay Rhino Account browser cookies
store Rhino Account passwords in the repository
commit installer bytes, license keys, license bundles, cookies, or access tokens
use a standalone license file copied from another Mac as if it were portable
start Rhino when any required authority gate is unresolved
note: Passing this authority gate permits preparation; it does not itself prove that Rhino is licensed, installed, runnable, or that SP02 has executed.
